The roll shows actual native gates and contacts, with written-hold changes counted separately. Native gate occupancy is measured, not acoustic decay. Each version discloses shared-channel same-pitch overlap ambiguity. No rhythmic occupied-window recall scheduling, semantic phrase/taste or full physical-playability claim. Pitch-return memory is separate. The unchanged exporter ends at score boundary; post-score soundfont decay is not included or certified. Full generated idea, no backing band or extra source context. Private generator implementation is not deployed. Native gate coverage of the score span: original 100%, space 88.89%, connected 97.22%. Measured PCM can continue in gate gaps because of soundfont release; coverage percentages are not percentages of audible silence.
